name: candor
description: Candour as a mechanism, not a pep talk. A blocking Stop gate carries the two dishonesty shapes a script can prove: a file:line citation resolving to no file under cwd or to a line past the file's end, and a position retracted after challenge-shaped pushback with no tool call in between. Flattery openers, apologies, defensive phrasing and emotional intensifiers are counted by /candor:check and blocked by nothing, on purpose. Ships the straight-talk skill: six orderings, not sentiments. Completion claims stay with code-architecture.
